About Me

I am an AI Engineer at KLA. I’m interested in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI - building and exploring systems that can see, understand, and connect different types of information. I graduated from the University of Southern California with a Master of Science in Computer Science (Artificial intelligence).

Previously, I was a Research Assistant at the USC HUMANS Lab under Dr. Emilio Ferrara where I worked on LLM behavior, reasoning and evaluation.
